children.title: Trump directs investigation of online fundraising allegations, including ActBlue claims
children.description_medium: On April 24, 2025, President Donald Trump issued a memorandum directing the attorney general, in consultation with Treasury, to investigate allegations involving unlawful straw-donor and foreign contributions through online fundraising platforms. The memorandum cited congressional findings involving ActBlue. ActBlue denied wrongdoing and described the action as politically motivated. The supplied sources do not establish a simultaneous March investigation of ActBlue and Open Society Foundations.
children.description_long: On April 24, 2025, President Donald Trump issued a memorandum directing the attorney general, in consultation with the Treasury secretary, to investigate allegations of unlawful straw-donor and foreign contributions through online fundraising platforms. The memorandum cited congressional findings involving ActBlue. Reuters reported the action as targeting the Democratic fundraising organization, and ActBlue denied wrongdoing and characterized the move as politically motivated. The evidence supports a presidential directive for investigation of allegations; it does not by itself establish that DOJ simultaneously opened a formal investigation of both ActBlue and George Soros’s Open Society Foundations in early March. The available materials identify neither a separate Open Society action nor its date, scope or procedural status. The ActBlue-related memorandum can be drafted as a supported event, while any proposed Open Society component remains unresolved pending direct evidence. The memorandum directs an investigation into allegations; it does not report findings that ActBlue violated the law. The denial is ActBlue’s response to the action, not an independent adjudication of the underlying allegations.
children.date_uncertainty: Date is the presidential memorandum date; Reuters reported the action the same day.

unresolved_components.title: Separate DOJ scrutiny of Open Society Foundations
unresolved_components.reason: The proposed split item has no source URLs, and the claims list marks the alleged combined March investigations unsupported. Supplied evidence cannot establish a distinct DOJ action concerning Open Society Foundations.
unresolved_components.missing_evidence: A supplied primary document or credible report identifying the action, date, scope, and procedural status.

rationale: The April memorandum is directly sourced. The Open Society component lacks cited evidence and remains unresolved.
